Class SelectionView

java.lang.Object
views.View<SelectionController>
views.teamchoice.teambuilding.TeamBuilderView
public class SelectionView extends View<SelectionController>
Main view for the Bugémon selection screen. Coordinates the two sub-views: BugemonGridView and TeamPanelView. Sub-views are loaded via fx:include in selectionview.fxml. JavaFX injects sub-controllers as bugemonGridController and teamPanelController after FXML loading, following the fx:id + "Controller" naming convention.

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Called automatically by JavaFX after all FXML fields are injected, including sub-controllers from fx:include. This is the correct place to propagate the controller to sub-views, since bugemonGridController and teamPanelController are null before this point.

    • setController

      public void setController(SelectionController controller)
